full_judgment: 12. In all types of endowment, the purpose of founder is clearly expressed in the sankalpa while the renunciation divests the founder of his rights in the property dedicated. The defendant is not the founder of the deity. The deed of Endowment, Exhibit 3, clearly provided that though the lands were recorded in the name of Shrijukta Moulvi Khurram Khan Panny and others, the shebaits of Sree Sree Kalimata were in possession of the same and with a view to remove any complication in future regarding the deity's title, the shebaits of the kalimata took pattan of the lands from the Government. The recitals in the deed clearly disclosed that the deity is a public debuttor which is being used as such for years together by the Hindu community.
